swaps.fable_reason: Cryptek's '{1}{B}, {T}' sacrifice-and-return loop is a repeatable artifact-leaves-graveyard trigger with any outlet, not the narrow one-turn saver the audit assumed.
swaps.note: Was: KEEP rank 3, 'KEEP (note: Cryptek's own graveyard return is an Imotekh trigger, but Dread Presence is stronger).'

swaps.why_in: "it has all activated abilities of all creature cards in all graveyards.": copies Szeras's sacrifice-for-mana, Syr Konrad's mill and Chronomancer's draw from the graveyard.
swaps.why_out: Flayed One is a lifelink body with a one-time mill three.
swaps.verdict_reason: Fable overturned: better IN/OUT is Whisper, Blood Liturgist → Flayed One — the Ooze's payoff is thin (Szeras makes 0 mana off MV-0 Warriors; it is not an artifact card without Biotransference).
swaps.fable_reason: Necrotic Ooze needs the right card dead first and copies nothing useful off MV-0 Warrior tokens; Whisper, Blood Liturgist is a Dread Return every turn.
swaps.note: Was: KEEP rank 4, 'KEEP (reason fixed: Marionette Master's drain is triggered, so the Ooze does not get it).'

swaps.why_in: "put target creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. It gains haste.": steals the best creature in any graveyard, and persist does it twice.
swaps.why_out: Lychguard's only text returns legendary creature cards to hand for {3}{B} and itself.
swaps.verdict_reason: Fable overturned: better IN/OUT is Smothering Abomination → Lychguard — Puppeteer Clique needs a graveyard target the deck's own Darkness Crystal and Phyrexian Scriptures exile.
swaps.fable_reason: The Darkness Crystal exiles dying opponent creatures and Phyrexian Scriptures III exiles all opponents' graveyards, so Puppeteer Clique has nothing to steal; Smothering Abomination turns the Colossus loop into infinite draw.
swaps.note: Was: KEEP rank 5, 'KEEP.'

swaps.why_in: "You draw two cards and lose 2 life.": two cards for 2 mana.
swaps.why_out: Ominous Harvest usually copies 0-1 times off Gravestorm: about one card for 1 life.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP: Insatiable Avarice (the operator's 09-09 pick) stays, so nothing is reversed.
swaps.note: Operator owns 2 copies; singleton, so 1 goes here and the 2nd stays in the binder.
swaps.fable_reason: Two cards for {1}{B} at instant value, and Avarice (the operator's 09-09 pick) stays — no operator choice reversed; the second owned copy stays in the binder.

swaps.why_in: "Each opponent sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice.": a modal edict.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Imp's Mischief ('Change the target of target spell with a single target') is Imotekh's only protection.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: the report itself calls protection a real gap.
swaps.fable_reason: Imp's Mischief is the only protection the deck has.

swaps.why_in: "Deathtouch": a deathtouch artifact body.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Razorlash returns itself from the graveyard, usually for {B}{B}, a repeatable Imotekh trigger.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: the auditor misread Razorlash as unearth; Skorpekh has no engine text.
swaps.fable_reason: Razorlash's '{4}{B}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield' is a repeatable trigger, not a one-shot.

swaps.why_in: "This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each creature that died this turn.": a flash body sized by the turn's deaths.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Chronomancer's '{1}, {T}, Sacrifice another artifact: Draw a card' and its unearth are repeatable Imotekh triggers.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: Sautekh has no unearth, so the auditor's 'unearth cost' comparison compares against nothing.
swaps.fable_reason: Chronomancer's '{1}, {T}, Sacrifice another artifact: Draw a card' plus unearth beats Sautekh, which has no unearth to compare against.

swaps.why_in: "Whenever another creature or planeswalker you control enters, mill two cards.": mills 4 per Imotekh trigger, fuelling recursion.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Apprentice's 'each opponent loses 1 life' on every creature or artifact death is 3 per death in a 4-player pod.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: the auditor's 'one-point trickle' misreads 'each opponent'; Apprentice is one of three each-opponent drain payoffs.
swaps.fable_reason: Apprentice drains 'each opponent', one of three each-opponent drain payoffs.

swaps.why_in: "Massacre Girl deals 1 damage to target opponent and you gain 1 life.": a single-opponent drain on each death.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Zealot's 'Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Surveil 1' is a free sac outlet, defended in the auditor's own section 6.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: a 5-MV single-target drain that needs an outlet.
swaps.note: Two-deck conflict with Meren: neither deck gets it.
swaps.fable_reason: Zealot's 'Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Surveil 1' is a free sac outlet the deck depends on; two-deck conflict with Meren stands as no swap.

swaps.why_in: "{3}{B}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Return another target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.": one graveyard-to-hand rebuy.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Bauble is ramp, and the auditor's own report says ramp is thin.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: 'repeatable' is false; the cost exiles the Necromancer, so it works once.
swaps.fable_reason: Theoretical Necromancer's cost exiles itself from the graveyard, so it works once, not repeatably; Bauble is ramp the deck needs.

swaps.why_in: "Target opponent sacrifices a creature or planeswalker with the greatest mana value among creatures and planeswalkers they control.": instant edict on the biggest threat.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Wishclaw is one of two library tutors (Insatiable Avarice puts on top; Buried Alive is graveyard-only).
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: a role swap, not an upgrade; spot removal is already 5 pieces plus Noxious Gearhulk.
swaps.fable_reason: A role swap, not an upgrade; spot removal is already 5 pieces plus Noxious Gearhulk, and Wishclaw is one of two library tutors.

swaps.why_in: "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature. Whenever you sacrifice a creature, draw a card." Every Altar/Szeras/Zealot/Colossus/Deadly Dispute/Culling/Carnage/Winter sacrifice draws; the upkeep cost is itself a Warrior that fires Bats, Apprentice and Konrad — turning the Metalwork Colossus loop into infinite draw.
swaps.why_out: Lychguard's only text returns legendary creature cards to hand for {3}{B} and itself.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP: Fable review — replaces the audited Puppeteer Clique, whose graveyard targets are exiled by this deck's own Darkness Crystal/Scriptures.

swaps.why_in: "{T}, Sacrifice two creatures: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield." A Dread Return every turn: two Warriors in, the target's ETB plus two Warriors out (any creature card under Biotransference).
swaps.why_out: Flayed One's "Lifelink | When this creature enters, mill three cards" is the weakest body.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP: Fable review — replaces the audited Necrotic Ooze, a stronger IN for the same OUT.

swaps.why_in: "you become the monarch | At the beginning of your end step, if you're the monarch, return up to one target creature card from your graveyard to your hand | Whenever a creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life." A card, an Imotekh trigger and a drain per turn.
swaps.why_out: Razorlash is a 2/1 'can't block' whose {B}{B} rate needs an opponent with four nonbasic lands.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP: optional upgrade over Razorlash Transmogrant.
swaps.note: OPTIONAL.

swaps.why_in: "Whenever a Swamp you control enters, choose one" — a card or 2 damage off each of 32 Swamps.
swaps.why_out: Wayfarer's Bauble ('{1} then {2}, {T}, Sacrifice: search for a basic land, put it onto the battlefield tapped') is three mana for a tapped Swamp beside 5 rocks and Crypt Ghast.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP: Fable review — Cryptek is a repeatable Imotekh-trigger loop piece, not a narrow saver, so it should not be cut.
swaps.note: OPTIONAL: Cryptek stays either way; Emergency Weld here if the v3 Cryptek cut is reversed.

swaps.why_in: "{T}: Add {G} for each Elf you control.": ramp off 7 Elves that reach the battlefield (Mystic, Llanowar, Jaheira, Halsin, Tireless Provisioner, Disciple, itself).
swaps.why_out: No card cut: size fix, 99 to 100 cards.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP: mandatory size fix; Nesting Grounds stays.
swaps.fable_reason: Right 100th card: taps for 2-4 by turn 4 off 7 Elves (Mystic, Llanowar, Jaheira, Halsin, Provisioner, Disciple, itself); Nesting Grounds stays an operator keep.

swaps.why_in: "At the beginning of each upkeep, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.": four tokens a round, each also making a Took Food.
swaps.why_out: Emil's Fractal costs {4}{G} and a tap per token.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP.
swaps.note: Emil was an operator add in v3 on 09-28.
swaps.fable_reason: Four tokens a round, each a Took Food into Manufactor and Wurmlet/Trudge, beats Emil's per-token tap-and-{4}{G} rate.

swaps.why_in: "If you would draw a card except the first one you draw in each of your draw steps, draw two cards instead.": doubles the draws from Toski, Ohran, Idol, Took, Uprising and Kenrith's.
swaps.why_out: Ginger was the auditor's weakest-slot pick; the refuter did not contest the OUT.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP (reason fixed: doubling the life amount adds no Trudge Garden triggers; the value is doubled draws).
swaps.note: Ginger was an operator add in v3 on 09-28; confirm.
swaps.fable_reason: Doubles Idol/Toski/Ohran/Took/Return draws for one mana less than Ginger and independent of the monarch; the margin over Ginger is marginal but real.

swaps.why_in: "Exile this card from your hand: Add {G}.": free acceleration.
swaps.why_out: Hungering Puppetbeast is an EDHREC #27440 5-drop whose sacrifice ability grows only itself.
swaps.verdict_reason: Fable overturned: Elvish Spirit Guide is not worth the card — a card for one mana once, dead as a 3-mana 2/2 later — while Hungering Puppetbeast is the deck's only repeatable artifact-sac outlet, firing Trail of Crumbs, Unlucky Cabbage Merchant and Syr Ginger.
swaps.note: Was: KEEP rank 4, 'KEEP (reason overstated: its Food sacrifices still feed Trail of Crumbs).' Also: Puppetbeast was an operator add in v4 on 09-28; confirm.
swaps.fable_reason: The deck already runs three 1-drop dorks plus Wild Growth; Puppetbeast's Heartwood ETB and repeatable sac outlet are worth more.

swaps.why_in: "Whenever that creature deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker this turn, draw that many cards.": a big draw off a Trudge Garden 4/4 or a pumped token.
swaps.why_out: Spry and Mighty's X is the difference between two creatures' powers, which is small in a token deck.
swaps.verdict_reason: Fable overturned: a wash — Spry and Mighty reliably hits X=3-6 against this deck's 1/1 tokens beside 4/4 and 7/7 bodies at sorcery speed with +X/+X trample on two bodies; keep the operator's 09-18 sleeved pick.
swaps.note: Was: KEEP rank 5, 'KEEP.' Also: Spry and Mighty was an operator sleeved pick on 09-18; confirm.
swaps.fable_reason: Insight needs a connect that Toski and Ohran already pay for; Return of the Wildspeaker covers instant-speed draw.

swaps.why_in: "At the beginning of your upkeep, if there are 100 or more tower counters on this enchantment, you win the game.": an alternate-win mana sink.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: The Ooze makes a Mutagen token every turn, which Took and Manufactor multiply into Wurmlet and Trudge Garden triggers.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: the auditor quoted only The Ooze's first ability; Pinnacle duplicates the Walking Ballista kill.
swaps.fable_reason: The Ooze's 'Create a Mutagen token' is 4 artifact ETBs a turn with Took + Manufactor — correctly kept over the Ballista-duplicate Pinnacle.

swaps.why_in: "Equipped creature gets +3/+0 and has trample and lifelink.": lifelink on one attacker.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Propagator's 'Whenever another creature you control enters, you gain 1 life' makes it a second Trudge Garden loop piece.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: lifelink is one lifegain event per damage step.
swaps.fable_reason: Propagator is a second Trudge Garden loop piece; lifelink is only one lifegain event per damage step.

swaps.why_in: "{T}: Add {G} for each Elf you control.": Elf ramp.
swaps.why_out: Not cuttable: operator keep (HISTORY 09-18), and the cut takes the deck from 33 to 32 lands.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT the OUT only: the Archdruid enters as the 100th card instead (separate KEEP).
swaps.note: Operator keep.
swaps.fable_reason: Operator keep (HISTORY 09-18); the cut would take the deck from 33 to 32 lands. The Archdruid enters as the 100th card instead.

swaps.why_in: "Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn.": one turn of combat protection.
swaps.why_out: No card cut: the auditor proposed it as the 100th card.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: the operator removed Fog in v3 on 09-28; the 100th slot goes to Elvish Archdruid.
swaps.note: Operator removal.
swaps.fable_reason: The operator removed Fog in v3 on 09-28; the 100th slot goes to Elvish Archdruid instead.

swaps.why_in: "When this creature enters, empower Jace 2.": a 2-loyalty Jace token on a 3-MV artifact body.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Propagator is a round-1-protected Trudge Garden loop piece.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: judged without the false '[-3] right away' claim; empower 2 gives only 2 loyalty.
swaps.fable_reason: Empower 2 gives only 2 loyalty, not a '[-3] right away'; Propagator is a round-1-protected Trudge Garden loop piece.

swaps.why_in: "Whenever you cast an artifact or creature spell, untap Traxos.": a trampler that untaps on casts.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Jiang's end-step untap of all tokens doubles Jaheira token mana; Seedborn Muse covers only opponents' turns.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: no Food, token or lifegain text.
swaps.note: Two-deck conflict with Tazri: neither deck gets it.
swaps.fable_reason: Jiang's end-step untap of all tokens gives instant-speed Jaheira mana for Chord/Second Harvest/Return; Traxos has no Food, token or lifegain text.

swaps.why_in: "Return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand. You gain 4 life.": one rebuy plus one Trudge Garden trigger.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Titanbones' 'Whenever you gain life, put two +1/+1 counters' scales with every Food sac and grows without bound off the loop.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: not a clear upgrade.
swaps.note: Two-deck conflict with Meren: neither deck gets it.
swaps.fable_reason: Titanbones' counters scale with every Food sac and grow without bound off the loop; not a clear upgrade, and it is a two-deck conflict with Meren.

swaps.why_in: "Enchanted permanent is a Construct creature with base power and toughness 5/5 in addition to its other types.": turns a Manufactor or Idol into a 5/5 and rebuys itself.
swaps.why_out: Not cuttable: Ribtruss is an operator-sleeved pick, and Trudge Garden and Halsin tokens feed its devour.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: a two-card threat that dies to one removal spell; IF-OWNED.
swaps.note: IF-OWNED.
swaps.fable_reason: A two-card threat that dies to one removal spell; Ribtruss is an operator-sleeved pick and IF-OWNED.

swaps.why_in: "{T}: Add {G}" as a 2-drop dork or a land ("This land enters tapped. {T}: Add {G}"): a dork early, the 34th land when flooded on spells. It was in the operator's own 09-18 proposal and never reached the physical build.
swaps.why_out: Brawn's team trample only works 'As long as this card is in your graveyard', with no discard outlet in the list, and trample already comes from Uprising, Ghalta and the Fungus Beasts themselves.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP: Fable miss — still open.

swaps.why_in: "{T}: You gain 2 life" = a free Trudge Garden trigger every turn ({2} → 4/4 trample) and +2 Titanbones counters; under Seedborn Muse that is one per player turn. 'Creature spells you cast cost {X} less... X is the amount of life you gained this turn.'
swaps.why_out: Ghalta is the fourth trample grant and a finisher only; it was an operator add in v4 today.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP: optional — Ghalta already wins games the deck already wins.
swaps.note: OPTIONAL: it was an operator add in v4 today, so treat as optional.
